Although this does significantly affect the economic status of free pilots throughout the galaxy, the wisdom of our beloved Emperor cannot, and should not be challenged under any circumstances.|[[Gil Burtin]]|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
The '''Freelance Pilots Guild''', also known as the '''Free Pilots Guild''', was a an organization of [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] presided by [[Gil Burtin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
